scripts.dry-run: rolldown scripts/dryRun.ts --platform node --format esm --file .script-build/dryRun.mjs --log-level warn && node .script-build/dryRun.mjs
scripts.bakeoff: rolldown scripts/bakeoff.ts --platform node --format esm --file .script-build/bakeoff.mjs --log-level warn && node .script-build/bakeoff.mjs --mode recorded
scripts.bakeoff:live: rolldown scripts/bakeoff.ts --platform node --format esm --file .script-build/bakeoff.mjs --log-level warn && node --env-file-if-exists=../../apps/web/.env.local .script-build/bakeoff.mjs --mode live
scripts.schema-probe: rolldown scripts/schemaProbe.ts --platform node --format esm --file .script-build/schemaProbe.mjs --log-level warn && node --env-file-if-exists=../../apps/web/.env.local .script-build/schemaProbe.mjs
